import contextvars

def _t():
    c = contextvars.ContextVar('a')
    assert 'a' in repr(c), ('assertIn', 'a', repr(c))
    c = contextvars.ContextVar('a', default=123)
    assert '123' in repr(c), ('assertIn', '123', repr(c))
    lst = []
    c = contextvars.ContextVar('a', default=lst)
    lst.append(c)
    assert '...' in repr(c), ('assertIn', '...', repr(c))
    assert '...' in repr(lst), ('assertIn', '...', repr(lst))
    t = c.set(1)
    assert repr(c) in repr(t), ('assertIn', repr(c), repr(t))
    assert ' used ' not in repr(t), ('assertNotIn', ' used ', repr(t))
    c.reset(t)
    assert ' used ' in repr(t), ('assertIn', ' used ', repr(t))
try:
    _t()
except BaseException as _e:
    print('ORACLE_EXC ' + type(_e).__name__ + ' ' + repr(str(_e)))
else:
    print('ok')

import re as _re
import contextvars

def _t():
    c = contextvars.ContextVar('c')
    try:
        c.get()
    except LookupError as _exc:
        pass
    else:
        raise AssertionError('assertRaises: did not raise')
    assert c.get(None) is None, ('assertIsNone', c.get(None))
    t0 = c.set(42)
    assert c.get() == 42, ('assertEqual', c.get(), 42)
    assert c.get(None) == 42, ('assertEqual', c.get(None), 42)
    assert t0.old_value is t0.MISSING, ('assertIs', t0.old_value, t0.MISSING)
    assert t0.old_value is contextvars.Token.MISSING, ('assertIs', t0.old_value, contextvars.Token.MISSING)
    assert t0.var is c, ('assertIs', t0.var, c)
    t = c.set('spam')
    assert c.get() == 'spam', ('assertEqual', c.get(), 'spam')
    assert c.get(None) == 'spam', ('assertEqual', c.get(None), 'spam')
    assert t.old_value == 42, ('assertEqual', t.old_value, 42)
    c.reset(t)
    assert c.get() == 42, ('assertEqual', c.get(), 42)
    assert c.get(None) == 42, ('assertEqual', c.get(None), 42)
    c.set('spam2')
    try:
        c.reset(t)
    except RuntimeError as _exc:
        assert _re.search('has already been used', str(_exc)), 'assertRaisesRegex: message mismatch'
    else:
        raise AssertionError('assertRaises: did not raise')
    assert c.get() == 'spam2', ('assertEqual', c.get(), 'spam2')
    ctx1 = contextvars.copy_context()
    assert c in ctx1, ('assertIn', c, ctx1)
    c.reset(t0)
    try:
        c.reset(t0)
    except RuntimeError as _exc:
        assert _re.search('has already been used', str(_exc)), 'assertRaisesRegex: message mismatch'
    else:
        raise AssertionError('assertRaises: did not raise')
    assert c.get(None) is None, ('assertIsNone', c.get(None))
    assert c in ctx1, ('assertIn', c, ctx1)
    assert ctx1[c] == 'spam2', ('assertEqual', ctx1[c], 'spam2')
    assert ctx1.get(c, 'aa') == 'spam2', ('assertEqual', ctx1.get(c, 'aa'), 'spam2')
    assert len(ctx1) == 1, ('assertEqual', len(ctx1), 1)
    assert list(ctx1.items()) == [(c, 'spam2')], ('assertEqual', list(ctx1.items()), [(c, 'spam2')])
    assert list(ctx1.values()) == ['spam2'], ('assertEqual', list(ctx1.values()), ['spam2'])
    assert list(ctx1.keys()) == [c], ('assertEqual', list(ctx1.keys()), [c])
    assert list(ctx1) == [c], ('assertEqual', list(ctx1), [c])
    ctx2 = contextvars.copy_context()
    assert c not in ctx2, ('assertNotIn', c, ctx2)
    try:
        ctx2[c]
    except KeyError as _exc:
        pass
    else:
        raise AssertionError('assertRaises: did not raise')
    assert ctx2.get(c, 'aa') == 'aa', ('assertEqual', ctx2.get(c, 'aa'), 'aa')
    assert len(ctx2) == 0, ('assertEqual', len(ctx2), 0)
    assert list(ctx2) == [], ('assertEqual', list(ctx2), [])
try:
    _t()
except BaseException as _e:
    print('ORACLE_EXC ' + type(_e).__name__ + ' ' + repr(str(_e)))
else:
    print('ok')

import contextvars

def _t():
    ctx1 = contextvars.Context()
    c = contextvars.ContextVar('c', default=42)

    def ctx1_fun():
        c.set(10)
        ctx2 = ctx1.copy()
        assert ctx2[c] == 10, ('assertEqual', ctx2[c], 10)
        c.set(20)
        assert ctx1[c] == 20, ('assertEqual', ctx1[c], 20)
        assert ctx2[c] == 10, ('assertEqual', ctx2[c], 10)
        ctx2.run(ctx2_fun)
        assert ctx1[c] == 20, ('assertEqual', ctx1[c], 20)
        assert ctx2[c] == 30, ('assertEqual', ctx2[c], 30)

    def ctx2_fun():
        assert c.get() == 10, ('assertEqual', c.get(), 10)
        c.set(30)
        assert c.get() == 30, ('assertEqual', c.get(), 30)
    ctx1.run(ctx1_fun)
try:
    _t()
except BaseException as _e:
    print('ORACLE_EXC ' + type(_e).__name__ + ' ' + repr(str(_e)))
else:
    print('ok')
